text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One night during camp…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I've been pondering, Trainer. Has this thought ever dawned upon you?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: People say that the ruler of the sea, Poseidon, and the power he grants are merely the stuff of fairy tales.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: But Poseidon does exist.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Go on, listen for yourself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fsshhh! Fsshhh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Splash, splash…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Can you not hear something emerging from the deep?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Poseidon has come to spark the next stage of my evolution.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Splash, splash…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It does sound like footsteps in the water. But they couldn't possibly belong to Poseidon…
Heh heh, heh heh heh heh!
Your god of the sea doesn't exist. But…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: The Phantom Bird does!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Gah! It's you?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Es verdad! I'm the world's strongest, a member of the Golden Generation, and I'm hot on your heels!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa, the Phantom Bird, has landed!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A superstar runner with worldwide acclaim now stands before us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's one of the Umamusume from the Golden Generation that T.M. Opera O has set her sights on.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I know who you are, Opera O. You're the one aimin' to be the top ruler!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: But in this battle royale, you're on the receivin' end of everyone's attack. It's gonna be a world of hurt.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: H-how do you know this?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I've got a bird's-eye view over everything. There's nothin' that happens without me knowin'.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: So, I'll offer ya some pointers. Then you can fight with your head held high and come out victorious, no matter how many people are after ya!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oooh! Lending your strength to the Overlord, are you? Most appreciated!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: So, what do we do first? Some partner running?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: We're gonna wrestle.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: …Pardon?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: If you wanna learn to fight, there's nothin' better than wrestlin'! Go put on your ring attire.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm not entirely sure why, but Opera O ends up wrestling against El Condor Pasa.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ding!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Kay, Opera O, bring it! Fight like the overlord you say you are!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: What're ya gonna do when everyone's bearin' down on you?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Try takin' this, for starters! Condor Rush!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa unleashes a flurry of karate chops! T.M. Opera O, on the receiving end…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hah hah hah! 'Tis a simple matter!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: With my adept stage dancing, I can evade any and all attacks by the slimmest of margins!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: You see? This is how a true ruler does battle! Even if I come under a barrage of cannon fire, I can use my conserved energy to attain total victory!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: That's right, isn't it, El? This is what you wished to convey!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Interestin'. Sure, that style does conserve energy, but…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: That's not how a ruler fights!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Does an overlord just run and run, sneakin' their way to victory?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ngh! What?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Even if ya win, ya can't call that victory. That's no lordly fightin'… That's a tactic for cravens!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Aaagh?! Craven! I have never been paired with such a humiliating title!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: To have become the Craven Lord in my quest for strength—ohh, how I have fallen.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I'll show ya the type of fightin' you should be striving for!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: C'mon, Opera O! Lemme have your best finishing move!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: My… ultimate Overlord technique?! The one which can obliterate six galaxies in a flash?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This has gotten way too ridiculous for me to butt in. I decide to sit back and just watch.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Heh! Hehehe… As you wish. Do not regret it when you disintegrate to dust.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Prepare for my supreme move! The Overlord Principal Galaxion!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: BOOOOM!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She unleashes an explosive technique that defies all words!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Mnrrrgh!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: What?! You took the blow head-on?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: How can you still stand?! More importantly, why did you not evade? You're more than capable.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Why? 'Cause this is how a ruler fights!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Take everything they throw at ya… and win. A true champ doesn't run, even when it's you against everyone.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Takin' one on the chin gets the fans riveted! Fightin' back makes 'em roar!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Prove you've got the most muscle and overpower every last hit! That's what a real champ does!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Whoosh!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: What?! She vanished…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Aaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: WHOMP!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa drives T.M. Opera O into the sand with a powerful, high-speed tackle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ding, ding, ding!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The match is over, and important lessons have been learned.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: You have my thanks, El. My eyes are finally open after that flawless blow.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Even if my entire competition singles me out, I must meet them head-on. That is what makes the Overlord.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: No… That is how the Centurial Overlord does battle. Do I have it correct this time?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Sí. Tryin' for distance just means you're afraid of gettin' passed.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: The strong don't care if they win by a nose, 'cause they know for a fact nobody'll overtake 'em.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And with that said, hasta luego!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Yes! I swear to turn your teachings into shining success on the track!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the Phantom Bird returns to the sea.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Argh! Gulp! Ptoo! I shouldn't have tried to swim back!
